answer: Incident: 12 identities idled four epochs and kept full standing, so the decay rule never fired. Fix: decay the score 15% per idle epoch and 5% per unverified claim attached to it, recomputed at close. A sponsor may not audit its own recruit, so an orchard of clones rooted in the same karst cannot grade itself. An idle farm loses a fifth of its standing every epoch, and rebuilding it costs an ocean of fresh work paid at the same rate as everyone else.
